name: file-bridge
description: Local-first filesystem operations for AI agents — read, write, search, patch, and manage files with security sandboxing. Air-gapped, no cloud dependencies.
long_description:
File Bridge provides secure, local-only access to your filesystem. Built for regulated industries (finance, legal, marine) where data never leaves your infrastructure.

Features:
- Read/write/list/patch files with size limits and atomic operations
- Search file contents with ripgrep (regex, context lines, glob filters)
- Find files with glob patterns
- Path traversal protection (sandbox root enforcement)
- Symlink attack mitigation (configurable)
- Binary file detection and base64 encoding
- Structured JSON logging via structlog
- API key authentication for remote access
- Multiple transports: stdio (default), SSE, Streamable HTTP
- Runs on commodity hardware (AMD/DirectML optimized)
- Zero cloud dependencies — fully air-gapped

FILE_BRIDGE_ROOT_PATH.description: Root directory for all filesystem operations (sandbox)

FILE_BRIDGE_TRANSPORT.description: Transport protocol: stdio, sse, or streamable-http

FILE_BRIDGE_API_KEY.description: API key for SSE/HTTP authentication (required for non-stdio transports)

FILE_BRIDGE_ALLOW_ABSOLUTE_PATHS.description: Allow absolute paths in tool calls
